A package stuffed with marshmallows, graham crackers & both milk & dark chocolate. ​ SWEETHEARTS PACKAGE - $50: Want to have some bubbly waiting for you in the geodome when you arrive? We’ll make it happen! Message us to add this to your stay & enjoy some prosecco your first night in the dome to help you & your sweetheart unwind. Please provide 48 notice in order to prepare.
